CustomField.description: When the communication happened (defaults to now; editable for backdating). Orders the append-only deal message log. Replaces Entry_Date__c, whose _Date suffix asserted a date-only type it never had - this field stores date AND time, per ARCHITECTURE.md §1 rule 9.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Date AND time the call, email or meeting actually happened - not when it was logged. Backdate it if you are recording an earlier conversation; the log is ordered newest-first by this value.
CustomField.label: Entry DateTime
